# Exercise media and content

## Photographs and text

Exercise photographs in `media/exercises/` and the adapted Russian summaries in `gym-catalog.js` use the public-domain [Free Exercise DB](https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db), published under the [Unlicense](https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/LICENSE.md). The app retains the exact source record links for each exercise. Photographs were copied without changes. Russian summaries are shortened adaptations; personal notes are separate. Existing ACE/Mayo Clinic summaries retain their own source links.

## Looping video demonstrations

Author: **Goulart**, supplied through [wger](https://wger.de/), licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). All adapted videos and extracted posters in `media/videos/` are distributed under **CC BY-SA 4.0**. Changes: resized to 320 pixels high, converted to H.264 MP4 at 24 fps, sound removed; the incline-dumbbell clip has its initial camera setup trimmed. Posters are still frames extracted from the same videos. No endorsement is implied.
